summary: First end-to-end test of AIRX. Backend: created pytest suite (30 tests) covering all /api and /api/v1 endpoints -> 30/30 pass; APIx=100.43, 98,722 valid obs, 36 routes, validity 99.965%, CPI contribution 0.00033 pp all verified, AI /api/ai/explain returns real GPT-5.4 output (mode=ai_enhanced_intelligence) and deterministic fallback works. Frontend: Policy Intelligence Mode confirmed as default landing view, all 14 sidebar sections render with no runtime/page errors, mode toggle works, CPI simulator round-trips through POST /api/cpi-sensitivity/simulate in both Policy and CPI Sensitivity views, raw-data pagination works, API Explorer endpoint switching + Try Live works, AI Refresh updates text, Simulate Scrape shows a toast. Found 3 real integration defects (prop-name mismatches / non-functional timeframe buttons / wrong toast metric key) and several missing data-testids which I added.

minor.issue: timeframe (7D/30D/3M/6M/1Y) and aggregation (daily/weekly/monthly) query params are ignored - identical 13-point series returned for every combination. Makes the chart timeframe UI meaningless.
Field is named validity_pct while the spec/other endpoints use validity_rate (overview kpis uses validity_rate). Inconsistent naming across contracts.
Response has raw_scraped_records/valid_records but frontend reads res.new_observations -> toast always says '0 obs ingested'. Contract mismatch.

ui_bugs.issue: Airline tariff breakdown table is not rendered at all (TEST_IDS.ROUTE_AIRLINE_BREAKDOWN_TABLE unused). ROUTE_KPI_CHANGE testid also unused.
Timeframe buttons (7D/30D/3M/6M/1Y) only change button styling; no refetch/slicing of series (x-axis ticks stay at 13 for every timeframe). Unused chartType state as well.
Scrape toast always reads 'Pipeline cycle complete — 0 obs ingested' because App.js reads res.new_observations which backend never returns.
Route filter dropdown hardcodes only 5 routes while dataset has 36; airline/source lists also hardcoded instead of derived from API.
React console warning on every render of this view: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' (hydration warning). Native <select> used instead of shadcn Select.

integration_issues.flow: Policy briefing / Alerts drill-down -> Route Intelligence
integration_issues.issue: App.js passes selectedRoute/setSelectedRoute but RouteIntelligenceView destructures ({ routes, selectedRouteName, onSelectRoute }). Clicking 'BLR -> MAA' in the policy high-pressure list (or an alert action) navigates to Route Intelligence but always shows DEL-BOM. Selected route never propagates.
App.js passes leadTime={leadTime} but LeadTimeView expects prop leadTimeData -> prop is always undefined and view silently renders hardcoded fallback constants instead of /api/lead-time data.
App.js passes validation={validation} but ValidationView expects validationData -> always undefined, renders hardcoded r=0.91/MAE 2.7/RMSE 3.8 rather than /api/validation payload.

CpiSensitivityView/PolicyModeView simulate call setCpi() on the global App state, so a simulated scenario permanently overwrites the baseline CPI numbers shown elsewhere until reload. Consider keeping simulation result local or providing a Reset.

issues: 'IQR Interquartile Range' label is rendered on top of the blue IQR box and the median tick; blue-on-blue text is effectively illegible

Sidebar is always expanded (16rem fixed) with no hamburger/collapse, leaving ~130px for main content; headings wrap one word per line and pipeline DAG cards are clipped. No responsive layout for mobile/tablet.
Copy cURL falls back to toast.error('Clipboard unavailable') when navigator.clipboard is blocked; add a textarea/execCommand fallback so copy still succeeds

action_items: Fix prop name mismatches in App.js/views: LeadTimeView (leadTimeData), ValidationView (validationData), RouteIntelligenceView (selectedRouteName + onSelectRoute) - currently three views ignore backend data / drill-down.
Make /api/index-series honour timeframe & aggregation params, and have AirfareIndexView refetch (or slice) on timeframe button click.
Fix scrape toast metric: use valid_records/raw_scraped_records from POST /api/pipeline/trigger-scrape.
Render the promised airline tariff breakdown table on Route Intelligence (route-airline-breakdown-table) and wire route-kpi-change.
Populate Raw Data filters (route/airline/source) dynamically from the 36-route dataset instead of 5 hardcoded routes.
Fix <span> inside <option> React warning in RouteIntelligenceView select; consider shadcn Select.
Fix IQR label overlap/contrast in the route box plot and add responsive sidebar collapse for mobile.
Standardise data-quality field naming (validity_pct vs validity_rate).
critical_code_review_comments: Views destructure prop names that App.js never passes (leadTimeData/validationData/selectedRouteName) and then silently fall back to hardcoded constants - this hides integration failures. Prefer explicit loading/empty states over baked-in fallback data so mismatches fail loudly.

Several views hardcode headline numbers (AirfareIndexView 100.43 / 100.00 / peak-trough, FareComponentsView 82/15/3, ValidationView r=0.91) instead of using API payloads; dashboard will show stale numbers when the dataset changes.

ESLint react/no-unstable-nested-components errors in AirfareIndexView:136, LeadTimeView:134, OverviewView:287, RouteIntelligenceView:227, ValidationView:169 (custom recharts tooltips defined during render) plus unescaped quotes in RawDataView:61.
AirfareIndexView keeps an unused chartType state; dead code.
server.py mounts CORSMiddleware after include_router and imports motor/db but never uses it for any endpoint - dead dependency.

Actual contract names to use: cpi_contribution_pp / airfare_cpi_weight_pct (not contribution_pp), validity_pct on data-quality, /api/index-series returns a bare LIST, /api/lead-time returns {windows, elasticity_overall}, /api/raw-data returns {total,page,page_size,total_pages,data}. Frontend testids I ADDED this round: cpi-fuel-shock-input / cpi-simulator-multiplier-slider / cpi-simulate-action-btn in CpiSensitivityView, timeframe-{7d,30d,3m,6m,1y}-btn + index-chart-container in AirfareIndexView, base/tax/fee-fare-share-value in FareComponentsView, api-endpoint-<id> fallback in ApiExplorerView. Still-unused testids: route-airline-breakdown-table, route-kpi-change, ai-model-select-dropdown, deterministic-toggle-switch, aggregation-select-dropdown (verify after main agent's fixes). Re-verify the 3 prop-name mismatches and timeframe filtering after fixes.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the three data-binding/drill-down defects is a prop-name contract mismatch between App.js renderView() and the view components' destructured props (leadTime vs leadTimeData, validation vs validationData, selectedRoute vs selectedRouteName). Because each view defines a hardcoded default object when the prop is undefined, the UI renders plausible-looking values and the failure is invisible without comparing against the API. Reproduction: click 'BLR -> MAA' in policy-high-pressure-routes-list -> Route Intelligence opens on DEL-BOM. Mitigation: rename props consistently and remove/lighten the hardcoded fallbacks. The timeframe-button no-op is a separate two-sided issue: backend ignores the timeframe param and the frontend never refetches on change.
